title: Momentum with point-in-time insider accumulation and institutional ownership
hypothesis: Proposed, not frozen: in a point-in-time dynamic liquid U.S. common-equity universe, an equal-weight rank composite of medium-term price momentum, corporate-insider accumulation and improving institutional ownership has positive net-of-cost mean daily excess return and higher independent zero-RF Sharpe than a matched momentum-only portfolio, with gains stable across chronological Development folds and later untouched evaluation windows.
rationale: Proposed economic mechanism, not an established result: momentum may reflect gradual information incorporation; publicly disclosed insider purchases may indicate management conviction; changes in disclosed institutional positions may indicate sustained demand. Their information may be complementary, but disclosure delays, crowding, confounding and trading costs could remove any incremental value.
expected_effect: Positive incremental net daily return and Sharpe for the full composite versus momentum alone. Lower volatility or drawdown alone does not confirm the return hypothesis. No unconditional promise of market outperformance or alpha.
falsification_conditions: Economic failure: full composite net mean daily excess return versus matched momentum-only is nonpositive, or its zero-RF Sharpe is no higher, in a later frozen evaluation window.
Statistical nonconfirmation: the predeclared paired moving-block excess-return test does not reject the nonpositive-effect null after Holm adjustment; lack of significance is not proof of no effect.
Robustness failure: the incremental effect is an isolated parameter optimum, dominated by one stock or regime, or disappears under predeclared cost and disclosure-delay stresses.
Incremental-information failure: the full composite adds no stable value beyond either momentum-plus-insider or momentum-plus-institutional ablation.
Design invalidation, not economic falsification: historical membership, filing availability, revisions or missingness cannot be audited point in time. Stop rather than substitute current snapshots.
confounders: Market beta, size, sector, value, liquidity and volatility exposures
Disclosure delays, reporting thresholds, transaction classification and filing amendments
Institutional holdings are reported positions, not contemporaneous fund flows
Survivorship, delisting treatment, symbol changes and present-day universe membership
Vendor backfills, revisions, stale values and nonrandom signal coverage
Momentum crashes, crowding, capacity, turnover, spread and slippage
Selection over families and parameters; modern model knowledge of historical events
asset_universe: PROPOSED explicit PIT US exchange-listed common-stock universe; excludes OTC and unsupported subtypes, retains delisted histories; exchange vintages remain UNRESOLVED

dynamic_universe.definition: PROPOSED primary: explicit historical security_id/ticker effective-span reconstruction at each decision; CS common stocks only, nominal unadjustedClose >= USD 5 and USD 10m trailing dollar volume from 20 distinct, valid, completed prior exchange sessions on a compatible price/volume basis. Retain securities that later delist. Exclude ADR/ADRC/ADRP/ADRR, ETF, PFD, funds, units, warrants, rights, unknown subtypes and ambiguous identities. Historical US exchange versus OTC evidence is required; absent exchange vintages cannot be guessed. Market cap is removed from primary eligibility and the grid because PIT share vintages are not certified. ALL_US_STOCKS is not trusted as a historical membership substitute. USD 25m is robustness only. All seven signal families use the same certified price, insider and institutional coverage universe; missing signals are excluded, never zero-imputed. Actual primary membership cannot be instantiated until exchange, adjustment basis and source-completeness gates pass.

permitted_indicators: VERIFIED sample declaration: PriceRateOfChange(asset,length,interval=Day); revised 180/365 calendar-day horizons evaluated natively. Prior-completed-price lag requires explicit verified composition; four regular January opens support IndicatorWindowAgo(operand,12.5,Hour), including weekend carry-forward, not comprehensive guarantees.

PROPOSED sole insider representation: distinct ownerCik among unambiguously mapped, disclosed nonderivative P/A purchase legs certified open-market, using 30/90 calendar-day public-availability windows. P alone includes private purchases; classification and amendment chains are critical UNRESOLVED blockers. BuyCount and BuyValue are diagnostics only.

PROPOSED sole institutional representation: matched-manager holder-count change between the two most recent eligible public quarter cohorts, fixed proposed 60-calendar-day buffer, source availableAt and versioned amendments. Native NetHolderChange does not establish this matched-cohort policy. NewHolders/NetShareChange are diagnostics; filing-recency optimization removed.

PROPOSED eligibility only: stable historical CS identity, unadjusted nominal USD 5 floor, fixed lagged 20-session compatible-basis USD 10m ADV; exchange/OTC, session uniqueness and adjustment basis unresolved. No primary cap or prospective rebalance gate.

execution.event_rationale: Required to audit dynamic membership decisions, timestamped signal inputs, holdings, submitted/filled orders, costs and corporate actions. Verify that Nexus events actually expose this evidence; missing fields remain unresolved. Events must be extracted first when authorized jobs eventually complete.
execution.assumptions: PROPOSED: monthly only, first tradable session of month, 09:30 America/New_York execution. Information cutoff 21:00 America/New_York on preceding calendar day; only availableAt <= cutoff, complete prior market sessions and certified historical versions may enter. Equal signal-rank weights, equal security weights, 95% deployment, no leverage/shorts. Weekly is robustness only. Native CurrentTimeHours()==9.5 schedules sample open fills. IndicatorWindowAgo(Price/PriceRateOfChange,12.5,Hour) reproduced previous completed close in four January 2016 open evaluations including a weekend; one-day lag instead used prior open. This is sample evidence, not a full scheduling/disclosure/PIT guarantee. DST, holidays, early closes, monthly scheduling, native cohort reconstruction and source version vintages remain UNRESOLVED. Proposed 400-calendar-day warmup is not finalized and is not supplied by a January 2014 price extraction for January 2015 inception. Development start/folds remain conditional, never selected from performance. No candidate execution or freeze authorized.

robustness_tests: Chronological inner selection and five proposed expanding Development-only walk-forward folds with audited warmup/embargo; exact boundaries unresolved; no outer Validation tuning

Paired moving-block bootstrap of aligned daily excess returns: proposed 20-session blocks, 10000 draws, seed 2002. Proposed one-sided null-centered tests and Holm familywise alpha 0.05 across full-versus-momentum, full-versus-momentum-plus-insider and full-versus-momentum-plus-institutional in all confirmatory windows. Exact inventory and p-value implementation UNRESOLVED; existing percentile intervals do not supply adjusted p-values.

Superseded 453-unit plan is not a server preview or guaranteed upper bound. Require audited ledger enforcement before freeze; current generic 1000-unit planner guard is not proof of this experiment-level ceiling.

Revised conditional ledger: 34 distinct signal-family cells plus two benchmarks per expanding fold, five folds; 281 future evaluations including 20 failed/unresolved reserve, plus eight already attempted diagnostic backtests = 289 projected total backtest evaluations. Lake jobs are counted separately. No server preview or execution authorization. Regime labels are local partition diagnostics, not additional jobs; any extra job consumes reserve and must enter the ledger.
